lines.en: label chikaonsen1:
I tap on Chika’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Chika 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: Now that I know Yumi’s going to be watching Chinami, I feel a little less bad about stealing Chika away for a night.
lines.zh: 现在知道 Yumi 会照看 Chinami，把 Chika 抢出来过夜的愧疚感就少了一点。

lines.en: And given how excited she was for the prospect of spending some time alone with me, I’m sure she’ll be ready to go as soon as I give the word.
lines.zh: 而看她那么期待能跟我单独相处，我敢肯定我一开口她就能走。

lines.en: In fact, she’d probably ditch work even if she was on the clock right now.
lines.zh: 事实上，她多半会翘班，哪怕现在正在上班。

lines.en: Not that I want her to do that or anything.
lines.zh: 倒不是我想让她那样。

lines.en: But...it would be kind of nice, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过……那样也挺好就是了。

lines.en: It’s a good feeling having so many lives that revolve around yours.
lines.zh: 有那么多人的生活都围着你转，这种感觉挺好的。

lines.en: : Hihi~ Good morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗨嗨～早上好，Sensei。

lines.en: : Morning. Are you busy today?
lines.zh: : 早。你今天忙吗？

lines.en: : I’m actually off today!
lines.zh: : 我今天其实休息！

lines.en: : Really? Don’t you work every weekend, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你周末不是都要上班吗？

lines.en: : Yup! But I had a feeling that today was gonna be that day, you know?
lines.zh: : 对啊！不过我有种预感今天会是那个日子，你懂吧？

lines.en: : ...Your period?
lines.zh: : ……你的生理期？

lines.en: : What? No. I meant the day you invite me out.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我是说你约我出去的日子。

lines.en: Thank God.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地。

lines.en: : So, are you ready to go?
lines.zh: : 那，你准备好出发了吗？

lines.en: Saying “Yes” will trigger a four part event that will last until Sunday morning.
lines.zh: 选「是」将触发一个四段式事件，一直持续到周日早上。

lines.en: Are you absolutely sure you’re ready to go?
lines.zh: 你确定准备好出发了吗？

lines.en: menu:
Yes
lines.zh: 是

lines.en: : Let’s do it. Start packing now.
lines.zh: : 来吧。现在就开始收拾。

lines.en: : Heheh~ It’s only one night. It’s not like I need to bring all of my stuff.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～就一个晚上而已。又不用把全部家当都带上。

lines.en: : I’ll just grab my charger and some underwear and start heading over to your place. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 我拿上充电器和几件内衣就出发去你那儿。行吗？

lines.en: : You’re coming here?
lines.zh: : 你来我这儿？

lines.en: : Duh. Unless you want to stop by here. But that’s like, totally out of the way since there’s a bus stop right around the corner from your place.
lines.zh: : 废话。除非你想来我这儿。不过那也太绕了，你家附近就有公交站。

lines.en: : True. Alright, sure.
lines.zh: : 也是。行，那就这样。

lines.en: : Let me know when you’re here.
lines.zh: : 到了跟我说一声。

lines.en: : Yup! See you soon, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 好！待会儿见，Sensei！

lines.en: Chika hangs up and I take a seat on the bed, wondering what a one-night vacation with her will wind up being like.
lines.zh: Chika 挂了电话，我在床边坐下，琢磨着跟她共度的一夜假期会是什么样。

lines.en: scene black
jump onsenbegin
No
lines.zh: 否

lines.en: : Actually...on second thought, maybe we should wait a little bit?
lines.zh: : 其实……再想想，我们是不是再等等？

lines.en: : What? How come?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Ami and I already have plans tonight.
lines.zh: : 我好像跟 Ami 今晚已经有安排了。

lines.en: : Ugh...stupid Ami.
lines.zh: : 呃……讨厌的 Ami。

lines.en: Living with a [niece] shows off its convenience once again.
lines.zh: 跟[侄女]住一起的好处又一次显现了出来。

lines.en: : Fine...but only because I like you so much.
lines.zh: : 好吧……但这只是因为我太喜欢你了。

lines.en: : You’re lucky you have a girl like me, you know? Not many people would offer up a chance like this just to let you do whatever you want with it.
lines.zh: : 你有我这样的女孩可真是走运，知道吗？没几个人会给你这样的机会，任你随意处置。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’m glad that you exist.
lines.zh: : 是是。我庆幸你的存在。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta go, though. Enjoy your day off, Chika.
lines.zh: : 不过我得挂了。好好享受你的假期，Chika。

lines.en: : Guhhhh...Maybe someone will let me take one of their shifts or something now that I know I’m not busy?
lines.zh: : 呜……既然知道我今天不忙，说不定能让谁把班让给我？

lines.en: The two of us hang up and I suddenly have to figure out something else to do today.
lines.zh: 我们俩挂了电话，我突然得想点别的今天要做的事。

lines.en: jump callmorning
label onsenbegin:
scene wintersky
Chika shows up around an hour later with only one bag.
lines.zh: 大约一小时后，Chika 出现了，只带了一个包。

lines.en: I know she mentioned not needing much but, for some reason, I expected her to be the type to pack her entire closet away for even a short trip.
lines.zh: 我知道她说过不用带多少东西，但不知为何，我以为她会是那种连短途出行也要把整柜衣服都打包的人。

lines.en: The two of us make our way to the bus station and decide to remain standing so as to not freeze ourselves against the cold steel of the bench.
lines.zh: 我们俩到了公交站，决定站着等车，免得被长椅的冷钢冻僵。

lines.en: She tells me a little more about the hot spring. How it’s not really a place someone like her could ever afford without little miracles like this.
lines.zh: 她又跟我讲了些那家温泉的事。说要是没有这种小奇迹，那本来不是她这种人消费得起的地方。

lines.en: The fact that she refers to it as a “miracle” is actually quite humbling.
lines.zh: 她管它叫「奇迹」，这听着还挺让人惭愧的。

lines.en: I never thought of myself as the type to be involved in anything miraculous, let alone a miracle with a girl that is far too good for me by every stretch of the word.
lines.zh: 我从没想过自己会跟什么奇迹沾边，更别说跟一个无论从哪方面看都优秀得配不上我的女孩共享的奇迹。

lines.en: I guess that applies to most of the girls I hang around, though.
lines.zh: 不过我接触的大多数女孩应该也是这样。

lines.en: But I probably shouldn’t be thinking of any of them right now.
lines.zh: 但我现在大概不该想她们中的任何一个。

lines.en: If Chika’s going to be kind enough to use something like this on me instead of someone else she's close with, the least I can do is give her my undivided attention.
lines.zh: 既然 Chika 好心把这样的东西用在我身上而不是她亲近的别人身上，我至少该全神贯注地对她。

lines.en: scene black
scene firstonsen1
: Soooo...you like?
lines.zh: : 所以嘛……喜欢吗？

lines.en: We arrive at the onsen half an hour later and receive yukata to change into.
lines.zh: 半小时后我们到了温泉，领了浴衣换上。

lines.en: I shrug mine off because I’m too stoic and manly to ever be seen in something like that, but Chika happily accepts hers and scurries off to a changing room to put it on right away.
lines.zh: 我把浴衣推到一边——我太沉稳、太有男子气概了，绝不会穿那种东西，但 Chika 穿上她那件简直美呆了。

lines.en: And now...here we are.
lines.zh: 而现在……我们就到了这里。

lines.en: In a completely unfamiliar environment, face to face with one another and-
lines.zh: 在一个完全陌生的环境里，面对面地——

lines.en: : You are adorable.
lines.zh: : 你真可爱。

lines.en: scene firstonsen2
: Heheh~ Thanks!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～谢谢！

lines.en: : I haven’t worn one of these in ages. I’m surprised I even remembered how to put it on.
lines.zh: : 我好多年没穿这个了。真没想到自己还记得怎么穿。

lines.en: : I hope it is equally as easy to take off.
lines.zh: : 希望脱下来也一样容易。

lines.en: scene firstonsen3
: [chikamaster]...we’ve only been here for five minutes and you’re already trying to rile me up?
lines.zh: : [chikamaster]……我们才到五分钟，你就开始撩我了？

lines.en: : What if I wanted this to be a completely wholesome weekend without any of those extra-curricular activities you’ve started having me do?
lines.zh: : 要是我想过一个完全纯洁的周末，不搞你最近让我做的那些课外活动呢？

lines.en: : I’d say that you should probably put on normal clothes because it is hard to not get excited right now.
lines.zh: : 那我会说你最好换回普通衣服，因为你现在这个样子很难不激动。

lines.en: : Just don’t get too excited or someone’s bound to notice.
lines.zh: : 别激动过头就行，不然肯定会被人注意到的。

lines.en: scene firstonsen4
: Why aren’t you wearing yours, by the way? Isn’t that like, disrespectful or something?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你怎么不穿你的？那不是有点……不尊重或者什么的吗？

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. I don’t think I’d look normal in one of those.
lines.zh: : 我没事。我觉得我穿那种东西不会像个正常人。

lines.en: : Really? I think you’d look hot.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我觉得你穿会很好看。

lines.en: : Thanks. But I’ll stick to my normal clothes for-
lines.zh: : 谢谢。不过我还是穿我自己的衣服——

lines.en: scene firstonsen5
: Get out of here, peasant!
lines.zh: : 滚出去，贱民！

lines.en: : This hot spring belongs to me!
lines.zh: : 这家温泉是我的！

lines.en: : Do yourselves a favor and run off before I call security!
lines.zh: : 识相就在我叫保安之前赶紧跑！

lines.en: : But...we have tickets.
lines.zh: : 可是……我们有票。

lines.en: : You look a little [young]to be the owner of an onsen.
lines.zh: : 你看着也太[年轻]了点，不像是温泉的老板。

lines.en: scene firstonsen6
: Silence! I am Tsukasa Tsukioka of the Tsukioka family! A very powerful, 5,000 year old wizard!
lines.zh: : 住口！我是 Tsukioka 家的 Tsukasa Tsukioka！一位非常强大的、五千岁的法师！

lines.en: Tsukioka? Why does that name sound familiar?
lines.zh: Tsukioka？这名字怎么听着耳熟？

lines.en: : I own many hot springs! Now, be gone!
lines.zh: : 我名下有好多温泉！现在，滚吧！

lines.en: : Another wizard.
lines.zh: : 又一个法师。

lines.en: : Just like Chinami...
lines.zh: : 跟 Chinami 一样……

lines.en: scene firstonsen7
: Tsukasa, dear...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，亲爱的……

lines.en: : Yes, mother?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，妈妈？

lines.en: : I was just informing this lovely [young]couple of the amenities this facility has to offer.
lines.zh: : 我刚才正在向这对可爱的[年轻]情侣介绍本店的设施。

lines.en: : Oh?
: So I didn’t just hear you talking about being a wizard again?
lines.zh: : 那我刚才没听到你又在说自己是法师？

lines.en: : Whatever do you mean, Mother? Why would I ever say something as silly as that?
lines.zh: : 您说什么呢，母亲？我怎么会说那么傻的话？

lines.en: scene firstonsen8
: Hah...please forgive my daughter.
lines.zh: : 哈……请原谅我女儿。

lines.en: : It’s not often that she gets to converse with those outside of the manor, so she gets a little excited at times.
lines.zh: : 她很少有机会跟宅邸外的人说话，所以有时候会有点兴奋过头。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. It’s fine. I have a sister her age, so I kinda get what you mean.
lines.zh: : 哦，没事的。我有个跟她同龄的妹妹，所以大概懂您的意思。

lines.en: : I’m Chika. Are you two actually the owners of this place? It’s absolutely beautiful so far.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Chika。你们俩真是这儿的老板吗？到目前为止这地方漂亮极了。

lines.en: : I mean...we still haven’t made it out of the entrance. But it was suuuuper nice on the outside.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们其实还没走出入口。不过外面真的超————好看的。

lines.en: scene firstonsen9
: Oh dear, pardon my manners.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，失礼了。

lines.en: : I'm Tsubasa. And I assume you’ve already heard my family name from my daughter here.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Tsubasa。我想你已经从我女儿那儿听过我们的姓氏了。

lines.en: : We do own this building, but we’re not here very often.
lines.zh: : 这栋楼确实是我们的，但我们不常来。

lines.en: : We just happen to be on a little retreat right now as my husband renovates our own hot spring.
lines.zh: : 我们只是刚好在这儿小住，因为我丈夫正在家里翻修我们自己的温泉。

lines.en: : I have another daughter who was supposed to be joining us, but it seems she had other matters to attend to this evening.
lines.zh: : 我还有个女儿本该一起来的，不过她今晚好像有别的事要处理。

lines.en: : How disappointing Big Sister can be at times.
lines.zh: : 姐姐有时候真让人失望。

lines.en: : Does she not understand that a place like this is a truly splendid environment for mothers and daughters to bond?
lines.zh: : 她难道不明白，这样的地方是母女增进感情再好不过的环境吗？

lines.en: scene firstonsen10
: You love your mom a lot, huh?
lines.zh: : 你很爱你妈妈吧？

lines.en: : She is perfectly adequate. Though, I do wish she’d allow me a bit more freedom like Papa does.
lines.zh: : 她还算过得去。不过我倒希望她像爸爸那样多给我点自由。

lines.en: : And you are?
lines.zh: : 那你是？

lines.en: : You can just call me Sensei.
lines.zh: : 叫我 Sensei 就行。

lines.en: : Oh? You’re a teacher? Kumon-mi Academy or [kumon_mi_high]?
lines.zh: : 哦？你是老师？Kumon-mi 学院还是[kumon_mi_high]？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Chika, which one is ours again?
lines.zh: : Chika，我们是哪个来着？

lines.en: scene firstonsen11
: [kumon_mi_high], Sensei.
lines.zh: : [kumon_mi_high]，Sensei。

lines.en: : Sorry. The names are so similar that I wind up confusing them pretty frequently.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。两个名字太像了，我经常搞混。

lines.en: : That’s hilarious. Do you enjoy teaching there?
lines.zh: : 真逗。你喜欢在那儿教书吗？

lines.en: : My oldest daughter attends Kumon-mi Academy, but I can’t say I’m exactly pleased with their...performance so far.
lines.zh: : 我大女儿在 Kumon-mi 学院上学，不过我对他们目前的……表现可不太满意。

lines.en: : Yeah. Crazy how they’d do something as outside of the curriculum as falling into a sinkhole.
lines.zh: : 是啊。他们居然会干出掉进塌陷坑这种课外的事，真离谱。

lines.en: scene firstonsen12
: Hahahahah! Hilarious!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！太好笑了！

lines.en: : I forgot how funny people could be outside of the manor!
lines.zh: : 我都忘了宅邸外面的人原来这么有趣！

lines.en: : Mother? Papa told us not to laugh at commoners because it’s rude.
lines.zh: : 妈妈？爸爸说过不能嘲笑平民，那样不礼貌。

lines.en: scene firstonsen13
: I’m not laughing at them, Tsukasa dear. I’m laughing because Sensei said something funny.
lines.zh: : 我没在嘲笑他们，Tsukasa 亲爱的。我笑是因为 Sensei 说了句好笑的话。

lines.en: : Now, come with me and leave these two alone. I’m sure they didn’t come all the way here to converse with a little girl and an old woman.
lines.zh: : 好了，跟我来，别打扰这两位了。他们大老远跑来，肯定不是为了跟一个小女孩和一个老太太聊天。

lines.en: : You’re not old. You look the same age as me.
lines.zh: : 您不老啊。您看着跟我一个年纪。

lines.en: scene firstonsen14
: Apologies, again. I meant older than your...tastes, given the lovely [young_girl] you’ve shown up with.
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉。我是说，比起你带来的这位可爱的[年轻女孩]，我比你……的口味要年长一些。

lines.en: : Now, please do excuse us.
lines.zh: : 那么，请恕我们失陪。

lines.en: scene firstonsen15
: Bye bye, peasant man!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，平民先生！

lines.en: : Do enjoy your stay at Casa del Tsukasa!
lines.zh: : 祝您在 Tsukasa 庄园住得愉快！

lines.en: : Good day to both of you.
lines.zh: : 祝二位愉快。

lines.en: scene firstonsen16
The two rich girls wander into what looks like a sauna and leave Chika and I to ourselves in the entryway again.
lines.zh: 这两位富家女孩踱进了像是桑拿房的地方，把 Chika 和我留在了这儿。

lines.en: : That was...umm...interesting.
lines.zh: : 那真是……呃……有意思。

lines.en: : Do you think she knows we’re like...here together?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她知不知道我们是……一起来的？

lines.en: : I’m fairly sure that much was obvious.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这挺明显的。

lines.en: : I’m more surprised by how casual she was about everything.
lines.zh: : 我更惊讶的是她对一切那么坦然。

lines.en: : Heheh...maybe we just look that good as a couple?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……也许是我们俩看起来就是那么登对？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I guess that must be it.
lines.zh: : 大概就是这么回事吧。

lines.en: scene black
We turn around and begin to head toward the room we were assigned to.
lines.zh: 我们转身朝分配给我们的房间走去。

lines.en: The halls are lined with ornate lights that don’t quite match the overall Japanese theme of the place, but they definitely don’t look bad either.
lines.zh: 走廊两侧装点着华丽的灯，跟整体日式风格不太搭。

lines.en: And it seems that despite this being on the more “high class” side, there really aren’t many rooms.
lines.zh: 而且看来，虽然这地方偏「高档」，房间其实没几间——

lines.en: Or people, for that matter.
lines.zh: 人也没几个。

lines.en: It’s remarkably empty.
lines.zh: 空得出奇。

lines.en: But I guess that just means it’ll be easier having some...”private time” in the hot spring.
lines.zh: 不过我想这意味着，在温泉里来一点……「私密时光」会更容易。

lines.en: scene firstonsen17
: Woah! This place is like, totally retro!
lines.zh: : 哇！这地方也太复古了吧！

lines.en: : I don’t even think there’s a TV in here!
lines.zh: : 这儿好像连电视都没有！

lines.en: : I think the whole point of places like this is to relax and detach yourself from normal society or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种地方的意义就是放松，暂时脱离正常社会什么的。

lines.en: scene firstonsen18
: And there’s only one futon~
lines.zh: : 而且只有一张被褥～

lines.en: : It looks tiny, too. We’re probably gonna have to cuddle if we both want to fit.
lines.zh: : 看着还挺小。我们俩要想都躺下，大概只能抱着睡了。

lines.en: : Oh no. What a horrible turn of events. However will we survive?
lines.zh: : 哦不。这发展也太惨了。我们可怎么活啊？

lines.en: scene firstonsen19
: Heheh~ I’m glad you’re just as excited as I am.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～真高兴你跟我一样兴奋。

lines.en: : This whole thing like, still hasn’t even set in for me I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 这整件事……我好像到现在都还没实感。

lines.en: : Like, if I heard at the beginning of the[school] year that I’d be talking about cuddling my teacher at some high class onsen, I never would have believed it.
lines.zh: : 要是[学]年初有人跟我说，我某天会在这家高档温泉跟我的老师讨论抱在一起睡觉，我绝对不信。

lines.en: : I feel like that applies to pretty much everyone once they start [high_school].
lines.zh: : 我觉得一旦上了[高中]，这话对所有人都适用。

lines.en: : We live in a sad world if people expect those things right away.
lines.zh: : 如果大家一上来就期待这种事，那这世界也太可悲了。

lines.en: : You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思。

lines.en: : It’s just crazy how far we’ve come in such a short amount of time.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得很不可思议，我们这么短的时间就走到了这一步。

lines.en: : Like, it doesn’t even feel like just one[school] year. You know?
lines.zh: : 感觉都不像才一个[学]年。你懂吗？

lines.en: : Oh, I know very well.
lines.zh: : 哦，我太知道了。

lines.en: Or at least better than you ever will, Chika.
lines.zh: 至少比你这辈子都会更知道，Chika。

lines.en: scene firstonsen20
: Soooo...now what do we do?
lines.zh: : 那……我们现在干嘛？

lines.en: : Hell if I know. This is your trip.
lines.zh: : 鬼才知道。这是你的旅行。

lines.en: : Not like there’s much to do here other than like...relax or bathe.
lines.zh: : 反正这儿除了……放松或者泡澡，也没什么可做的。

lines.en: scene firstonsen21
: Want to make out?
lines.zh: : 想亲热吗？

lines.en: : And that. That’s also a thing we can do.
